correctness.rationale: The proof normalizes the two smooth triple-contact conics over F_q using their Frobenius-fixed points to C:XZ-Y²=0 and D:XZ-Y²+YZ=0. The tangent incidence identity (s-t)²+t=0 is verified symbolically. Finite rational flags have t=-u², s=u-u² and the exact Poncelet map u→u−1; this yields q/p oriented cosets, precisely the single degenerate F_p coset, and a fixed-point-free reversal pairing on the remaining cosets. Therefore N=(q-p)/(2p) for all odd q=p^r. This rules out simple prime-field polygons without denying geometric closure. Independent exact F_{p²} coset counts for p=3,5,7,11,13 corroborated counts 1,2,3,5,6 and the integer incidence identity; the proof, not those tests, covers all r. Characteristic 2 and other contact types are outside scope.

It classifies every simple rational polygon in the fixed natural intersection type, not a finite example or an arbitrary slice.

limitations: Only odd-characteristic smooth ordered conics with geometric intersection divisor 3P+Q; all vertices and sides rational; no claim for type (4), characteristic two, or nonsimple polygons.
